training.recovery_selection: latest saved recovery by step only, never validation score
training.sampling: Same 25% color quartets, 25% navigation, 40% state calibration, 10% retained primitive schedule. State calibration uses one same-image quartet [v,-v,0,v/2] per microbatch; domains 25/25/50% and tasks 2..6 cycle. Common flow noise/time across the quartet; t=1 on even steps, sampled common time on odd steps. Other sampling unchanged.
training.loss: Flow matching on six normalized action channels, weights [8,8,1,4,1,1], divided by their sum. Runtime units and normalization unchanged.
training.data: Same dataset12 images, states, task prompts, and sampling. Relabel navigation xy/yaw only.
training.frozen_backbone: All vision-language parameters; train action expert and state/action projections only. Verify frozen parameter digest before and after training.
training.image_domains: Explicit per-image domains; new views are appended after the 6408 existing image IDs.
training.noise_schedule: For step=1..6000 and micro=0..1, use the frozen runtime Gaussian realization if (step+micro)%4<2, otherwise fresh random noise. 50% each. Existing common-noise quartet rules and flow-time schedule unchanged.
training.rationale: The requested person can leave the camera frame during translation. Teach yaw to center that person while preserving the same world stop goal and navigation translation law. Primitive/landing labels and runtime remain unchanged.

teacher.scope: Training labels only; frozen velocity-to-attitude controller already subtracts current estimated velocity.
teacher.nonhorizontal_labels: Preserve vertical and takeoff/landing requests; add yaw for airborne navigation tasks0/1. All primitive and landing labels are byte-identical to dataset12.
teacher.reason: Train12 dev01blue lost the target at the image edge; all existing navigation yaw labels are zero despite off-center training views. Primitive cases passed. Preserve train12 primitive labels and add navigation centering only.
teacher.stationary_horizontal_command: -1.2 * input estimated horizontal velocity; norm cap0.2m/s, constant32 steps. Zero unarmed or takeoff below0.25m.
teacher.yaw_target_rule: For armed rotation above0.8m: initial predicted yaw=own_yaw+1.0*own_yaw_rate. Iterate32 times at0.1s; rate=0 inside0.03rad else clip(0.8*(target-predicted_yaw), +/-0.25).
teacher.navigation_yaw_rule: When armed above0.8m, yaw=0 inside0.05rad of target-person bearing; otherwise clip(-0.8*bearing,+/-0.25rad/s). Positive command is clockwise. Update heading and body-frame velocity each0.1s during the approximate32-step teacher rollout.
teacher.navigation_world_goal: Same teacher goal: person position + [-1.0m,0] in the room plane. Scoring goal remains [-0.9m,0].

data.unchanged: All image/state/task input arrays, English prompts, sampling pools, flow-time/noise schedule, loss weights, primitive/landing targets, runtime and scoring.

evaluation: Unchanged: dev 8/8; exposed stress >=14/16, >=7/8 each color, >=3/4 each layout; regression 5/5; known failure 1/1; then fresh matched 16 per model and preregistered static probe.
hypotheses_not_results: Navigation yaw may keep the requested person in view during approach; learned behavior still needs complete closed-loop evaluation.
The same translation law is expressed in the changing body frame during teacher rollout. No simulator truth is added to model inputs.
All training inputs are reused from audited data; no development images/states are added. Final round02 remains unexposed.
All primitive/landing labels remain byte-identical, but shared-parameter interference is possible and every regression gate still applies.
Continuation training and a new fixed seed prevent isolated causal attribution to the new yaw labels alone.

resources.training: Windows GPU, no WSL training; no flight concurrent with training
resources.scope: Project WSL process tree only; other user workloads and global WSL settings untouched
